caption: The drawing depicts the interior of an industrial workshop or factory, predominantly colored in muted tones of grey, white, red, and brown. There are two large red and black fire extinguishers, one on a rolling cart at the right front and another mounted on a pillar in the left-middle. Several red fire hoses are mounted on the wall or rolled up, and a coiled grey hose is hung behind a red barrier in the left foreground, under a white sign reading "DO NOT TAMPER WITH HOSE." To the far left, there are blue-wheeled racks and a gray barrel with a hose attached. Two large black barrels with orange lids and tools atop them are in the left foreground. At the center, a large metal chamber labeled "DANGER RESTRICTED AREA LACQUER VAT" takes up most of the background wall, with a metal vent hood extending upward. Inside the chamber, a rack and heater are visible. In front of it is a brown wooden worktable with a metal toolbox and parts, and a wheeled cart carrying a metallic part. To the right of the chamber, two red and white fire extinguishers hang on a wall labeled "WEN FAN," and various tools and pipes are strewn across the floor. Large industrial windows at the back and right show some cranes outside. Overhead, green lamp fixtures hang from white beams, and various pipes run along the ceiling and walls. The floor is a mix of brown and grey, with a red rectangle marked "KEEP CLEAR" in white letters in the center foreground. Labels are visible throughout, detailing specific storage areas, equipment, and safety warnings.
title: Japan Lacquer Dipping Vat
